title: Agency men say they follow the Varginha investigation

tellings.quote: and they're, "Oh, yeah. No, we know exactly what you've been doing."

plain: James Fox, who has been investigating the Varginha case, a reported capture of a live alien by the army, says he once met government agency men who told him they were watching his work. He says he was there, and that they told him, "Oh, yeah. No, we know exactly what you've been doing," with a person named Leslie part of the account.
